categories.high_severity: Words that are strictly offensive (slurs, intense sexual language, family insults). These will be blocked.
categories.low_severity: Words that are mild insults or slang. These will trigger a warning but not a block.

notes: Standalone 'chod'/'chodo' NOT included due to innocent context in Hindi ('leave it/let it go')
Compound slurs like 'madarchod', 'behenchod' are included in high_severity
Leetspeak variations included (e.g., f*ck, f4ck, f00k)
